label: Non-invasive assessment of glymphatic dysfunction in middle cerebral artery stenosis based on DTI-ALPS and ro-ALPS.
summary: Middle cerebral artery stenosis (MCA-S) impairs cerebral perfusion and vascular pulsatility, potentially disrupting cerebrospinal fluid dynamics. We evaluated perivascular diffusivity in MCA-S using diffusion tensor image analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) index and the redirected ALPS (ro-ALPS) index, and assessed their clinical correlations.
